| POWER *. *Total power of a group of Tusken Raiders depends on how many are present. One has a total power of 1, two = 3, three = 6, four = 10. Limit of four at one site. Deploy only to Tatooine, but may move elsewhere. || {{Errata hl|Deploys only on Tatooine}}. {{Errata hl|W Power = 1, +1/2 for each other non-unique Tusken Raider present (limit three other Tusken Raiders that may add to power)}}. || Deploys only on Tatooine. {{Errata hl|Power +1 if another non-unique Tusken Raider present}}. {{Errata hl|If you have four or more non-unique Tusken Raiders present, your total power here is +2}}.

== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original [[Tusken Raider]], [[Tusken Raider (Errata)]], and [[Tusken Raider (PC Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata (Glossary Supplement) · PC Errata (Appendix A). Do not transclude onto Japanese, Unlimited, Two-Player, foil, or (V) articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per real Errata face; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
